name: Delicious Caviar Blini
desc: Blini topped with glossy black caviar. Each plump bead gleams like a tiny black pearl with a subtle sheen. With a gentle bite, the pillowy blini give way to the fresh, briny pop of the roe, the two melting together in perfect harmony. It is as though the finest bounty hidden beneath the frozen seas has been gathered into a single bite.

value.text: Increases all party members' ATK by 228 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
